projects.title: KeyMitra — A Key to Everyday Ease
projects.description: UI/UX and app design for a DRM team project with around 30 Mumbai keymakers. Field research informed digital customer records and key-blank inventory. Qualitative usability testing informed refinement; measured outcomes are not supplied.

projects.title: Dear Zindagi — Student Film Introduction
projects.description: A teacher’s brief to shoot an introduction for a favourite film. Savita chose Dear Zindagi because it felt relatable and filmed this student introduction while learning photography and videography.
